title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Measured Neutron Flux Profiles of the SAFARI-1 Research Reactor
abstract: arXiv:2611.17351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge of the neutron flux distribution is essential for safe and effective reactor utilisation. In the SAFARI-1 research reactor, a set of axial flux profiles are periodically measured by activating natural copper wires inserted along the height of the fuel or control assemblies and subsequently measuring their activity using a sodium iodide detector. Improper wire insertion can, however, result in profiles that do not accurately represent the actual neutron flux distribution. Building on previously identified potential indicators of improper wire insertion, an automated approach based on unsupervised learning was developed to detect anomalous axial flux measurements. The measured data were preprocessed using missing-value imputation, decay correction, and normalisation. translated_title: SAFARI-1研究反应堆中子注量率测量剖面的无监督异常检测
translated_abstract: 掌握中子注量率分布对于反应堆的安全和高效利用至关重要。在SAFARI-1研究反应堆中，通过活化沿燃料组件或控制组件高度插入的天然铜丝，并用碘化钠探测器测量其活度，从而周期性地获得一组轴向注量率剖面。然而，铜丝插入不当可能导致所测剖面无法准确反映实际的中子注量率分布。在先前识别出的铜丝插入不当潜在指标的基础上，本研究开发了一种基于无监督学习的自动化方法，用于检测异常的轴向注量率测量数据。测量数据首先经过缺失值填补、衰变校正和归一化等预处理，随后采用高阶多项式拟合来表征轴向注量率剖面并提取描述其形状的特征，再利用基于密度的空间聚类方法进行异常检测。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于无监督学习的自动化异常检测方法，通过高阶多项式拟合提取轴向注量率剖面的形状特征并结合密度聚类，有效识别SAFARI-1研究反应堆中因铜丝插入不当导致的异常中子注量率测量数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an automated unsupervised learning approach that uses high-order polynomial fitting to extract shape features of axial flux profiles and density-based clustering to detect anomalous neutron flux measurements caused by improper wire insertion in the SAFARI-1 research reactor.
